works.title: FLUENT.TYPE
works.desc_en: Shape 78 glyphs with six sliders, fine-tune the Bézier nodes by hand, then export your own typeface as SVG or OTF.
works.desc_zh: 用六個參數即時塑造 78 個字符，拖曳貝茲節點親手微調，再把自己的字體匯出成 SVG 與 OTF。

works.title: Chromatic Moiré Lab
works.desc_en: Drag a transparent grating and watch tiny shifts grow into waves, colour vibration and six-frame animation.
works.desc_zh: 拖曳透明光柵，讓細小位移被放大成波動、色彩震動與六幀動畫；從黑白錯視，走向色彩與時間錯視。

works.title: TRACE
works.desc_en: Tap, drag and hold. Your gestures become geometry and colour, then slowly fade once you let go.
works.desc_zh: 點擊、拖曳與停留，讓手勢化成幾何與色彩；放開後，痕跡緩緩消散。

works.title: Nocturne Mesh
works.desc_en: Classical chiaroscuro meets a digital point cloud: a net of night that keeps reshaping itself in a Perlin-noise flow field.
works.desc_zh: 古典明暗對比與數位幾何點雲，在 Perlin Noise 流場中形成一張持續變動的夜之網。

works.title: 24 Breaths
works.desc_en: Twenty-four breaths form an island: a living constellation of Taiwan's Apple Distinguished Educators, resonating with one another.
works.desc_zh: 二十四個呼吸構成一座島。從《夜巡之網》的生成語法，轉化為臺灣 ADE 社群彼此影響、連結與共振的生命星座。

works.title: Elastic Orbit
works.desc_en: Approach, pull and drag until a stable ring drifts off balance. The imbalance is not a fault; it is the force your looking leaves behind.
works.desc_zh: 靠近、牽引與拖曳，使原本穩定的環形結構產生偏移；失衡不是故障，而是觀看留下的力量。

works.title: Luminous Kaleidoscope
works.desc_en: Come close and linger: faint light folds, lags and remembers. After your hand leaves, the space is still slowly recalling.
works.desc_zh: 觀看者的靠近與停留，使微光被折疊、延遲並留下記憶；手離開後，空間仍在緩慢回想。

works.title: Geometry in Motion
works.desc_en: Circles, squares and triangles pull, bounce and return to a shared rhythm. Bring a fingertip or cursor near and they answer.
works.desc_zh: 圓、方與三角形彼此牽引、彈開、回到流動的節奏。以指尖或游標靠近，讓形狀回應你的存在。
